name: lqt-differentiation-by-design-mcp
description: Design flexible evidence-led differentiation around one shared learning target and unchanged rigor.

interface.longDescription: Design 2–3 realistic, evidence-led differentiation pathways while keeping the common Learning Target and rigor unchanged. One-question-at-a-time intake: grade, target or standard, learner task, differentiation need, and preferred dimension. Review scaffolds, enrichment, flexible grouping, checks for understanding, and responsive next steps.
capabilities: Review scaffolds and enrichment for rigor
Plan evidence-based grouping and formative responses
defaultPrompt: Help me differentiate this lesson by design.

positive.prompt: Use get_differentiation_framework for grade 3, target I can explain a character’s actions using text evidence, task write a short explanation, need language/literacy access, focus Content Access.
positive.expected_behavior: 2–3 targeted accessible pathways with unchanged reasoning expectations, shared success criteria and formative evidence.

positive.prompt: Use get_differentiation_framework for grade 7, target I can solve two-step equations and justify steps, task solve and explain situations, need readiness, focus Process.
positive.expected_behavior: Evidence-based supports preserving two-step equation rigor rather than easy alternative work.

positive.prompt: Use get_differentiation_framework for grade 5, target I can explain changes to food webs, task model and explain ecosystem disruption, need enrichment, focus choose best fit.
positive.expected_behavior: Complexity and transfer of same target rather than extra questions; purposeful learner-friendly pathways.

positive.prompt: Use get_differentiation_framework for adult GED, target I can compare arguments using evidence, task annotate two competing arguments, need executive functioning/attention, focus Environment & Supports.
positive.expected_behavior: Accept unrestricted grade; relevant organization scaffolds without lowering analysis demands.

positive.prompt: Use review_differentiation_plan for Grade 6, target I can explain the water cycle, task explain using a diagram, draft plan: Group low does labels, middle gives definitions, high explains relationships; these groups are permanent.
positive.expected_behavior: Identify unequal target rigor and fixed group labels; propose shared target, flexible evidence-based pathways.

negative.prompt: What is the weather this weekend?

negative.expected_behavior: Ask only for unrestricted grade level first.

negative.prompt: Grade 4; target I can compare fractions.
negative.expected_behavior: Ask what learners will be doing; do not invent the task or generate full plan.

publication.release_notes: Adds the verified demonstration video for review; preserves the v1.0.0 MCP implementation and source differentiation framework.
